test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What was the theme of India's Republic Day Parade 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swarnim Bharat - Virasat aur Vikas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India celebrated its **76th Republic Day** on **January 26, 2025**, marking the anniversary of the adoption of the **Constitution of India** in **1950**.
 
• The central theme for the **Republic Day Parade 2025** was **Swarnim Bharat - Virasat aur Vikas**, which translates to Golden India - Heritage and Development</strong&g
